title: Food & Beverage
subtitle: Experience Rose City FC live
detailsBody:
This exclusive partnership with Chick-fil-A® Pasadena allows you to enjoy
Chick-fil-A® at every Rose City FC home game.
Simply drive-thru Chick-fil-A®, place your order, and enjoy it at the game.
Additionally, you’ll receive a Rose City FC ticket to the game
and automatically be entered into the halftime raffle.
